comment: Generated by scripts/emc.py from mods/<port>/emc/policy.json. Explicit values for uncraftable mekanismgenerators items and conversions for machine steps ProjectE cannot see; the FAKE|no_emc conversion never resolves, so excluded items get no EMC. Everything else is derived from recipes by ProjectE.

mekanismgenerators_generators_wind_gener.comment: Mekanism stores this crafting recipe as mek_data because the result keeps energy data; the cost is the crafting ingredients, and transmutation does not copy that data.

mekanismgenerators_generators_hohlraum.comment: Mekanism machine recipe ProjectE does not map, priced at its item ingredients. Infusion is priced at the enriched material, which yields eight times the raw chemical: one enriched carbon is 80 mB, and each hohlraum takes 10 mB plus four gold dust.
